RBA fourth rate hike looms; home loan applications down 15% since budget per CBA; house prices forecast to fall up to 10%
Iron ore shakeout masked by war-driven demand; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle; Dalaroo and Lindian expand critical minerals exposure
TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo flagged to break gas cartel; energy transition costs mounting
ASIC probes KPMG for misleading regulator; Bathla collapse cited as symptom of broader Ponzi-economy fragility
AUD under pressure from inflation concerns; Australia's per-capita growth stalls behind Canada
Data centre boom attracts US caution; big tech faces community backlash; Nvidia signals AI cycle intact

sectors.trend: Banks lead ASX higher but face structural headwinds: 15% drop in home loan applications, record house-price fall forecasts, and fee-pricing scrutiny on CBA/Westpac loyal customers. Diversa super trustee under fire over $777k executive bonus.
sectors.implications: Near-term earnings support from higher rates, but credit-quality and volume risks build. Fee litigation and ASIC/KPMG probe add regulatory overhang. Net: mixed for CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX.

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout concealed by war-driven demand; Macarthur clears WA bulk test; Dalaroo launches 12,000m African gold drilling; Lindian signs 20-yr Kazakhstan rare-earths offtake; Critical Resources targets NZ gold-antimony.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face latent demand risk once geopolitical premium fades. Small-caps (Dalaroo, Lindian, Critical Resources) offer critical-minerals upside. Macarthur (MCR.AX) de-risks WA project.

sectors.trend: Oil rises on Persian Gulf tanker attacks; TMK Energy gas rates surge; Beetaloo flagged to disrupt gas cartel; energy transition costs 'run off the rails'.
sectors.implications: Positive for WDS.AX, BRL.AX, TMK.AX near-term. Structural gas-price support for Beetaloo (BTO.AX). Transition-cost narrative pressures renewables names.

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging; Victorian healthcare system called 'fundamentally broken'.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated but watch global biotech sentiment. Domestic healthcare providers face funding pressure. Selective opportunity in med-tech.

sectors.trend: Housing construction to follow prices lower; 10% house-price fall forecast; Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with population growth; EV adoption carries hidden costs.
sectors.implications: Headwind for REITs (GPW.AX, ICPL.AX) and building-materials names. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) benefit from rate-sensitive consumer pullback.

sectors.trend: Australia braces for data centre boom; US urges caution; community backlash intensifies; Nvidia signals AI cycle intact; Shopify and Spotify pursue AI-driven growth.
sectors.implications: Long-term infrastructure upside for AGL.AX, CSG.AX (power demand). Short-term permitting and NIMBY risk. Global tech sentiment mixed.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike cycle vs. housing credit contraction
Geopolitical risk (Iran/Persian Gulf) supporting oil and gold, masking iron ore demand weakness
Critical minerals and rare-earths expansion across ASX small-caps
Regulatory scrutiny: ASIC/KPMG probe, super-trustee bonus controversy, bank fee loopholes
Energy transition cost overruns and gas-market consolidation
Data centre build-out as structural power-demand driver
AUD inflation-driven strength vs. stalling per-capita growth

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and housing credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour dividend-paying financials with strong capital buffers; monitor CBA home-loan pipeline.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran/Persian Gulf conflict and oil-supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX/BRL.AX; monitor Brent and AUD/USD; maintain gold allocation (GOLD.AX, NVL.AX) as safe haven.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shakeout post-geopolitical premium
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure-play iron ore (RIO.AX, FMG.AX) toward diversified miners (BHP.AX) and critical-minerals names.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Regulatory / corporate-governance risk (KPMG, ASIC, super trustees)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor ASIC proceedings; avoid over-concentration in financial-services intermediaries; watch Diversa-linked super fund flows.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD overvaluation and stalling per-capita growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure for export-oriented miners; favour domestic-revenue companies (WES.AX, WOW.AX).

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil/gas price support
opportunities.rationale: Persian Gulf tanker attacks and TMK gas-rate surge provide near-term price tailwinds; Beetaloo gas-cartel disruption adds structural support.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective critical-minerals and gold small-cap exposure
opportunities.rationale: Lindian 20-yr offtake, Dalaroo African drilling, and Critical Resources NZ targets offer asymmetric upside in critical-minerals theme.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain quality bank exposure for dividend yield
opportunities.rationale: Banks lead ASX higher; higher-rate environment supports NIM despite volume softness; CBA.AX and NAB.AX offer 6%+ yields.

defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house-price fall forecast, 15% home-loan application drop, and construction slowdown create multi-quarter headwind.
War-masked shakeout in iron ore demand poses downside for pure-play miners once geopolitical premium fades.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hold gold and quality defensives as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Iran conflict escalation and crypto/silver sell-off support gold; consumer staples offer rate-cycle resilience.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate in a narrow range. Banks and energy support the index, but housing-credit contraction, RBA hike fears, and Iran conflict create volatility. AUD may spike on inflation data. Expect 1–2% index swings around geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural challenges (stalling per-capita growth, housing correction, energy-transition cost overruns) cap upside. Critical-minerals and data-centre power demand offer medium-term growth pockets. A 4th RBA hike risks a credit-cycle inflection. Bull case (headline 13) requires inflation to peak and housing to stabilise by H2 2026.

Iron ore demand data post-geopolitical premium
CBA/ANZ home-loan pipeline and credit-loss guidance
Iran/Persian Gulf conflict resolution or escalation

RBA cash rate and forward guidance
BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX share-price vs. iron ore correlation
ICAC proceedings on fugitive property developer
